item.title: Groenland Aucun accord ne portera atteinte à la souveraineté, assure le Danemark
item.description: Le Danemark et le Groenland ont assuré samedi qu'aucun accord avec les États-Unis ne porterait atteinte à la souveraineté du Groenland, après que le président Donald Trump a affirmé qu'un tel accord conférerait à Washington un "contrôle permanent" sur la sécurité de l'île arctique, sans toutefois en préciser la portée exacte.
item.dc:creator: Stine Jacobsen, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Tom Little
item.content:encoded: Le Danemark et le Groenland ont assuré samedi qu'aucun accord avec les États-Unis ne porterait atteinte à la souveraineté du Groenland, après que le président Donald Trump a affirmé qu'un tel accord conférerait à Washington un "contrôle permanent" sur la sécurité de l'île arctique, sans toutefois en préciser la portée exacte. Les États-Unis, le Danemark et le Groenland ont annoncé vendredi soir avoir conclu un accord prévoyant le développement d'une présence militaire américaine importante au Groenland, tout en interdisant aux adversaires des États-Unis d'y construire leurs propres bases. Les dispositions de l'accord, qui doit être signé durant l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies la semaine prochaine, n'ont pas été rendues publiques. On ignore ainsi quelle sera l'ampleur de la présence militaire américaine au Groenland ni si des concessions ont été octroyées à Washington sur la politique étrangère ou la gestion des ressources. Le Danemark et le Groenland ont exprimé l'espoir que l'accord, s'il se confirme, permette de mettre fin à des mois de tensions liées à la volonté de Donald Trump de s'emparer du territoire autonome danois. "La semaine prochaine pourrait être une bonne semaine – pour le Groenland, le Danemark et les États-Unis", a déclaré samedi le ministre danois des Affaires étrangères, Lars Lokke Rasmussen, dans un message publié sur Facebook. "Espérons qu'une période d'incertitude laissera place à un accord contraignant renforçant la sécurité dans l'Arctique et l'Atlantique Nord – et, par là même, notre sécurité commune au sein de l'Otan et de l'Europe – tout en respectant les lignes rouges du Royaume (du Danemark)", a-t-il ajouté. Le Premier ministre groenlandais Jens-Frederik Nielsen a déclaré, dans un autre message sur Facebook, que l'accord proposé reconnaissait "la souveraineté et l'intégrité territoriale de notre Royaume et du droit du peuple groenlandais à l'autodétermination". Par la voix d'un porte-parole, l'Otan a salué le projet d'accord, qui "contribuera à renforcer la sécurité, la stabilité et la coopération dans cette région vitale". Sur son réseau Truth Social, Donald Trump a déclaré que les Etats-Unis auraient "POUR TOUJOURS la capacité totale de faire ce qui est nécessaire au Groenland pour défendre la sécurité du Groenland et des Etats-Unis". L'accord "donne aux Etats-Unis le contrôle permanent sur la sécurité, et tous les autres besoins, du Groenland", a-t-il dit, ajoutant qu'aucun pays considéré comme un adversaire de Washington n'aurait le droit d'établir une présence militaire sur le territoire, ou d'y effectuer des investissements sensibles, sans l'aval du gouvernement américain. Les menaces de Donald Trump d'acquérir le territoire, voire de s'en emparer par la force, ont culminé en janvier et provoqué une grave crise diplomatique transatlantique. A l'issue de discussions à l'époque avec l'administration américaine, le Danemark et le Groenland ont déclaré que Washington s'était engagé à respecter la souveraineté du royaume danois et à accepter que le Groenland n'était pas à vendre. "Ce n'est probablement pas la fin des ambitions du président Trump pour le Groenland, et certainement pas la fin de l'intérêt stratégique des États-Unis pour ce territoire et ses ressources", a toutefois estimé Mikkel Vedby Rasmussen, professeur de sciences politiques à l'université de Copenhague, après l'annonce du projet d'accord.

item.title: England complete T20 sweep over Sri Lanka to go back on top of world rankings
item.description: Jos Buttler hit an unbeaten half-century as dominant England beat a sorry Sri Lanka by eight wickets to complete a 3-0 series whitewash and replace India on top of the T20 world rankings after the final match of the series in Manchester on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jos Buttler hit an unbeaten half-century as dominant England beat a sorry Sri Lanka by eight wickets to complete a 3-0 series whitewash and replace India on top of the T20 world rankings after the final match of the series in Manchester on Saturday. The win, with 62 balls to spare, was a 15th in a row for England over Sri Lanka in the format. Chasing a modest 125, after Sri Lanka collapsed to 124 all out with seven balls remaining, the hosts were 22-1 after opener Aneurin Donald was stumped for 13 but Buttler and captain Harry Brook then stepped up and took control, ending the six-over powerplay at 82-1. Buttler, who on Thursday became the first batsman to reach 15,000 career T20 runs, brought up his half-century with a six and sent England to a winning 126-2 with another as he added a top-scoring 62 from 32 deliveries to his tally while Brook contributed 33 before being run out. Brook ended as top overall scorer and player of the series. "I think everybody stepped up in this series," said Brook. "Every game has been slightly different and we're playing the conditions extremely well." Sri Lanka bowled nine wides, two going all the way to the boundary. England, unchanged from the side that [USN:L6N459172 TEXT:"won the second T20 by six wickets in Cardiff"] on Thursday, again won the toss and opted to bowl as they chased the sweep, with a strong breeze blowing at Old Trafford. Will Jacks, Jofra Archer and Player of the Match Sonny Baker took two wickets each as Sri Lanka faded after ending their powerplay at 47-2. Opener Pathum Nissanka (36 off 24) top scored for the visitors before being caught by Brook off Jacks while Kamindu Mendis was caught by Jacks off Archer for 35 from 28 balls. Wanindu Hasaranga (seven from six) knocked a bail off his own wicket after taking a hefty swing at an Archer delivery and tail-ender Eshan Malinga was run out for a duck by Liam Dawson while seeking a single. Captain Charith Asalanka was needlessly run out for 16 as Sri Lanka slumped to 83-4. "A very disappointing series for us in both the major departments, batting and bowling... this is an important eye-opener for us of where we stand right now in T20 cricket comparing to the best teams in the world," said Asalanka. "This is a time to get together as players, support staff, and our Sri Lanka cricket board as well to find solutions for these T20 problems. These are the best 15 players right now so we have to find solutions in the right way." England won the [USN:L6N4571AA TEXT:"first T20 in Southampton"] by 119 runs, with Brook scoring an unbeaten 114. England play three one-day internationals against Sri Lanka next week, starting at Durham's Chester-le-Street ground on Tuesday with matches at Leeds' Headingley on Thursday and London's Oval on Sunday.

item.title: FMI diz a ministros da UE que IA pode impulsionar crescimento, mas aumentar tensões econômicas
item.description: A inteligência artificial pode elevar a produtividade europeia em cerca de 1% ao longo de cinco anos, mas corre o risco de ampliar a desigualdade, sobrecarregar as redes de energia e aumentar a dependência de tecnologia estrangeira, a menos que os governos aprofundem a integração econômica, segundo um documento do Fundo Monetário Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Jan Strupczewski
item.content:encoded: A inteligência artificial pode elevar a produtividade europeia em cerca de 1% ao longo de cinco anos, mas corre o risco de ampliar a desigualdade, sobrecarregar as redes de energia e aumentar a dependência de tecnologia estrangeira, a menos que os governos aprofundem a integração econômica, segundo um documento do Fundo Monetário Internacional. A nota, elaborada para uma reunião informal dos ministros das Finanças da União Europeia em Dublin, nos dias 18 e 19 de setembro, informou que os benefícios e custos da IA provavelmente serão distribuídos de forma desigual entre países, regiões e trabalhadores. O documento afirmou que a conclusão do mercado único da UE ajudaria a difundir a adoção da IA e seus ganhos de maneira mais uniforme entre os 27 países do bloco. O documento ecoa as preocupações levantadas pelo ex-presidente do Banco Central Europeu Mario Draghi e pela Comissão Europeia de que os mercados fragmentados de capital, trabalho e energia da Europa estão impedindo o investimento e a inovação. O FMI estimou que cerca de 60% dos trabalhadores nas economias europeias avançadas estão empregados em ocupações altamente expostas à IA. Embora alguns possam se tornar mais produtivos por meio de ferramentas de IA, outros correm o risco de serem deslocados à medida que tarefas rotineiras são automatizadas, afirmou o documento, particularmente em empregos onde é mais provável que a IA substitua a mão de obra do que a complemente. De acordo com o documento, os centros de dados da Europa já consomem cerca de 3% da eletricidade do continente e a demanda aumentaria acentuadamente à medida que o uso da IA se expandisse. Grandes centros tecnológicos, como Frankfurt, Londres, Amsterdã, Paris e Dublin, estão entre as áreas mais expostas, com aglomerados de centros de dados já exercendo pressão sobre as redes elétricas locais. Para lidar com isso, a UE deveria investir em infraestrutura de rede transfronteiriça e aprofundar a integração do mercado europeu de energia, disse o FMI. O documento também alertou que a Europa corre o risco de desenvolver outra dependência estratégica, pois EUA e China dominam o desenvolvimento de modelos de IA. Afirmou que a Europa precisaria de investimentos significativos em seu próprio setor de IA para evitar ficar dependente de tecnologia estrangeira. Os ganhos da IA também provavelmente serão distribuídos de forma desigual entre os países e dentro da UE, segundo o documento. As economias mais avançadas devem se beneficiar de forma desproporcional, pois estão mais bem preparadas para a tecnologia e mais expostas a ela.

item.title: Marlins' Pete Fairbanks to undergo thoracic outlet surgery
item.description: Miami Marlins closer Pete Fairbanks will undergo surgery following a diagnosis of thoracic outlet syndrome.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miami Marlins closer Pete Fairbanks will undergo surgery following a diagnosis of thoracic outlet syndrome. The surgery date is not yet known, the team said Friday. Thoracic outlet syndrome is caused by the compression of blood vessels or nerves in the area between the shoulder and neck. It causes pain in that part of the body and also can trigger conditions such as numbness in fingers or a weak grip. Zack Wheeler, the Philadelphia Phillies star, was the most recent pitcher to have the surgery, doing so last August. He returned April 26 and has a record of 13-5 with a 2.99 ERA and 177 strikeouts in 150 1/3 innings this season. Fairbanks, 32, left three appearances this season with nerve irritation. The most recent occurrence came Monday in an 8-7 loss to the Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix. Entering with a 7-6 lead, Fairbanks pitched to one batter in the ninth, walking him on six pitches, and departed the game. The right-hander had just come off the injured list on Sept. 9 due to the same condition. Fairbanks signed a one-year, $13 million contract with the Marlins in the offseason, so this likely ends his brief career in Miami with a 4-5 record and a career-high 6.31 ERA in 46 appearances (one start) with 19 saves in 41 1/3 innings. He opened his career in 2019 with a brief stint with the Texas Rangers before being traded to the Tampa Bay Rays, where he pitched through the 2025 season. He has a career record of 24-29 with a 3.61 ERA in 321 appearances (three starts). He has thrown 306 2/3 career innings and totaled 109 saves and 389 strikeouts. --Field Level Media

item.title: Arteta vows Arsenal will learn from chastening Brighton defeat
item.description: There were no excuses from Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta after his side's perfect start to their Premier League title defence came to an ignominious end at Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday with a stunning 3-0 defeat in which they were out-hustled by their hosts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: There were no excuses from Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta after his side's perfect start to their Premier League title defence came to an ignominious end at Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday with a stunning 3-0 defeat in which they were out-hustled by their hosts. Arsenal won their opening four games of the league season, conceding just a single goal, but were undone by a superb Brighton performance that sees them move up to third in the table with 10 points from their five games. Arsenal dropped to second place on goal difference with 12 points from five games as they suffered their heaviest defeat in all competitions since a 3-0 home loss to Brighton in May 2023. Brighton took the lead following a superb strike from Pascal Gross as the ball went in off the post. Charalampos Kostoulas then finished from 25 yards and Chema Andres headed home a corner to add a third goal. “They deserved to win the game, they were the better team, especially in the early stages of the first half. We were not competing on the level that is required,” Arteta said. "We did technical errors in the wrong areas and lost our duels. “But I have to put into perspective what the team has done since the World Cup. I think it has been exceptional. We will learn from this experience and go again.” Brighton’s success was built on pressing Arsenal into submission and giving them little time on the ball, denying them control of the game. Arteta’s side were poor as a result, but that was also due to Brighton’s bravery and in the final third the home side were clinical, taking their Premier League tally to 16 goals in five games this season. Given that no other side has scored more than 10, free-scoring Brighton have emerged as one of the best teams to watch so far this season. The visitors were also uncharacteristically poor defending set-pieces and might have lost by a greater margin on another day. “It was the perfect performance from us,” Andres said. “The team was amazing, the intensity was what we needed to win against this amazing team. “It was my first Premier League goal and an important moment in the match for us to go 3-0 up. You cannot say it is game over against players of the quality of Arsenal, but the team kept pushing for the win.”

item.title: Casa Branca recusa entrada de repórteres de CNN, MS NOW e Politico após Trump anunciar veto
item.description: A Casa Branca negou acesso neste sábado a jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico, dando seguimento ao anúncio do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, de que os proibiria de entrar nas dependências do prédio.
item.dc:creator: Waylon Cunningham
item.content:encoded: A Casa Branca negou acesso neste sábado a jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico, dando seguimento ao anúncio do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, de que os proibiria de entrar nas dependências do prédio. Os três veículos de comunicação afirmaram, separadamente, que os crachás de imprensa de suas equipes foram confiscados na manhã de sábado, quando seus jornalistas se dirigiram à Casa Branca. Eles sinalizaram que podem contestar a proibição, alegando que ela entra em conflito com as garantias da Primeira Emenda da Constituição dos EUA relativas à liberdade de expressão e à liberdade de imprensa. Um comunicado da CNN divulgado no sábado classificou a proibição como “um ataque ilegal” ao seu direito constitucional de exercer o jornalismo sem interferência do governo. Em comunicados separados, a MS NOW e o Politico afirmaram que “defenderão nossos direitos garantidos pela Primeira Emenda”. A MS NOW disse que pretende “tomar todas e quaisquer medidas necessárias para defender nossos direitos garantidos pela Primeira Emenda e o papel essencial do jornalismo independente em nossa democracia”. CNN e MS NOW afirmaram que continuarão a fazer reportagens sobre o governo Trump, e o Politico declarou que apoia seus repórteres que cobrem a Casa Branca. Em uma postagem nas redes sociais na sexta-feira, Trump acusou os veículos de “divulgar NOTÍCIAS FALSAS” e afirmou que eles “não deveriam poder escrever ou divulgar constantemente FICÇÃO e MENTIRAS ao cobrir o presidente dos Estados Unidos”. Ele acrescentou: “Outros veículos de mídia de notícias falsas virão a seguir.” Ao falar com repórteres no Salão Oval na sexta-feira, Trump respondeu a uma pergunta sobre o que ele queria dizer com “outros veículos”, descrevendo o New York Times e o Washington Post como exemplos de “notícias falsas”, embora não tenha dito especificamente que os baniria da Casa Branca.

item.title: Heat G Pelle Larsson agrees to 4-year, $60M extension
item.description: Miami Heat guard Pelle Larsson has agreed to terms on a four-year, $60 million contract extension.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miami Heat guard Pelle Larsson has agreed to terms on a four-year, $60 million contract extension. The 2024 second-round draft pick's agents at CAA Sports confirmed the deal's details with ESPN on Friday. Larsson, 25, averaged 11.4 points, 3.5 rebounds and 3.4 assists in 70 games (54 starts) with the Heat in 2025-26. The Sweden native has averaged 8.4 points, 2.7 rebounds and 2.4 assists in 125 career games (62 starts) since Miami acquired him from the Houston Rockets in a draft night deal on June 27, 2024. --Field Level Media

item.title: USA CNN, MS NOW et Politico privés d'accès à la Maison blanche
item.description: Les journalistes de CNN, MS NOW et Politico ont été privés d'accès à la Maison blanche samedi, conformément à la décision annoncée par la veille par le président américain Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Waylon Cunningham
item.content:encoded: Les journalistes de CNN, MS NOW et Politico ont été privés d'accès à la Maison blanche samedi, conformément à la décision annoncée par la veille par le président américain Donald Trump. Les trois médias ont fait savoir que les accréditations de presse de leurs équipes avaient été confisquées samedi matin lorsque leurs reporters se sont présentés à la Maison blanche et qu'ils entendaient contester cette interdiction au motif qu'elle contrevient au premier amendement de la Constitution américaine garantissant la liberté d'expression et la liberté de la presse. Dans un communiqué, CNN a qualifié cette interdiction d'"atteinte illégale" à son droit constitutionnel d'exercer le métier de journaliste sans ingérence gouvernementale. Dans des communiqués distincts, MS NOW (ex-MSNBC) et Politico ont déclaré qu'ils "défendraient leurs droits garantis par le premier amendement". CNN et MS NOW ont déclaré qu'ils continueraient à couvrir l'actualité de l'administration Trump, et Politico a affirmé soutenir ses journalistes couvrant la Maison Blanche. Pour justifier sa décision, Donald Trump a accusé vendredi les trois médias de diffuser de fausses informations, ajoutant que d'autres médias suivraient. Interrogé par les journalistes dans le Bureau ovale sur ce qu'il entendait pas "d'autres" médias, le président américain a cité le New York Times et le Washington Post comme des exemples de "fausses informations", sans dire explicitement qu'il les priverait d'accès à la Maison Blanche. Dans un communiqué, le New York Times a qualifié la dernière décision de Donald Trump d'"anticonstitutionnelle" et apporté son soutien aux "organes de presse injustement ciblés par le président". Donald Trump a déjà interdit l'an dernier à l'agence Associated Press de faire partie des journalistes chargés de couvrir ses déplacements ("pools") car l'agence de presse avait refusé d'adopter l'appellation de golfe d'Amérique au lieu de golfe du Mexique, comme le réclamait le président. L'AP a contesté cette décision. Donald Trump a également fait pression à plusieurs reprises sur des chaînes de télévision pour qu'elle mettent fin aux émissions humoristiques ou d'actualité qu'il n'apprécie pas ou qui ont tourné en dérision ou critiqué sa personne ou son administration.

item.title: La Casa Blanca niega acceso a periodistas de CNN, MS NOW y Politico tras prohibicion de Trump
item.description: La Casa Blanca negó el sábado el acceso a periodistas de CNN, MS NOW y Politico, cumpliendo así con el anuncio del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que les prohibiría entrar al recinto.
item.dc:creator: Waylon Cunningham
item.content:encoded: La Casa Blanca negó el sábado el acceso a periodistas de CNN, MS NOW y Politico, cumpliendo así con el anuncio del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que les prohibiría entrar al recinto. Los tres medios de comunicación dijeron, cada uno por su cuenta, que las acreditaciones de prensa de sus equipos fueron confiscadas el sábado por la mañana cuando sus periodistas se presentaron en la Casa Blanca. Los medios han señalado que podrían impugnar la prohibición alegando que entra en conflicto con las garantías de la Primera Enmienda de la Constitución de Estados Unidos sobre la libertad de expresión y la libertad de prensa. En un comunicado emitido el sábado, la CNN calificó la prohibición de "ataque ilegal" a su derecho constitucional a ejercer el periodismo sin interferencias del Gobierno. En otros comunicados, MS NOW y Politico dijeron que "defenderían sus derechos amparados por la Primera Enmienda". En una publicación en redes sociales del viernes, Trump acusó a estos medios de "difundir NOTICIAS FALSAS" y dijo que "no deberían poder escribir o informar constantemente sobre FICCIÓN y MENTIRAS cuando cubren al presidente de los Estados Unidos". "Les seguirán otros medios de noticias falsas", agregó. En declaraciones a periodistas en el Despacho Oval el viernes, Trump mencionó al New York Times y el Washington Post cuando respondió a una pregunta sobre a qué se refería con "otros medios". El año pasado excluyó a Associated Press del grupo de periodistas que cubren sus movimientos porque la agencia de noticias no adoptó el nombre que Trump prefería para el golfo de México, después de que el presidente ordenó al poder ejecutivo llamarlo "Golfo de Estados Unidos". La AP ha impugnado la prohibición.

item.title: Real Madrid's strength of mind gives Mourinho confidence for Atletico derby
item.description: Jose Mourinho said the mental strength of his Real Madrid team gave him confidence heading into the derby clash at Atletico Madrid on Sunday despite problems with their game.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jose Mourinho said the mental strength of his Real Madrid team gave him confidence heading into the derby clash at Atletico Madrid on Sunday despite problems with their game. "In this second spell I've understood that it's getting more and more difficult to hear anything good about Real Madrid. It's not a problem to be conscious of our problems. But we are also conscious of the very good things we have in the team," Mourinho told a press conference on Saturday. "Alongside the quality it has, this team has a strength which is very significant, the strength of the group. This gives me confidence." The city rivals are separated by two points after six LaLiga matches this season. INCONSISTENT PERFORMANCES The last Madrid derby that Mourinho took part in as manager was the 2013 Copa del Rey final, an historic victory for Atletico over Real at the Bernabeu. Both sides will be seeking to set the tone for the early stages of the campaign, aware that last season's 5-2 victory for Atletico at the Metropolitano was a turning point in the trajectory of Xabi Alonso's tenure at Real Madrid. "A derby always has something extra. Derbies are history, culture, passion from the fans, players, coaches," said Mourinho. Los Blancos have just one victory in their last seven LaLiga trips to the Metropolitano and, with Barcelona already three points ahead of them, anything other than a win risks that gap widening. The Catalan side face Sevilla later on Saturday. Mourinho has started his second stint at Real Madrid with six wins from seven games, but inconsistent performances have sown seeds of concern about the evolution of his team. In spite of Diego Simeone's longevity at Atletico, his side are similarly in the early stages of finding a defined style and shape this season. Over the past three years, 22 new players have been signed by Atletico, giving a sense of continuous flux. Simeone has been without two of his natural forward options in the early stages of the season due to fitness issues. Alexander Sorloth is yet to feature, and Julian Alvarez has been limited to 145 minutes of action. A late arrival in the transfer window, Canadian striker Jonathan David made his first start on Wednesday. Alvarez has missed the last two matches due to a muscular problem but will play some part on Sunday. "He will be with us, we will see whether that's from the start or in the second half," Simeone told a press conference on Saturday. In terms of his approach to the match, the Argentine manager was keen for his side to limit turnovers of possession, saying Real Madrid carried more threat on the counter-attack in his eyes. Simeone advised his team to play decisively and with cool heads. "In the end, football is calmness. The talent, they have it. And above all, conviction. When you have conviction in what you're doing, it can go well or badly but you can sleep well at night," said Simeone.

item.title: Irán dice que comunicó condiciones para reanudar negociación y poner fin a la guerra con EEUU
item.description: Irán comunicó sus condiciones a los mediadores para retomar las negociaciones destinadas a poner fin a la guerra con Estados Unidos, dijo el jefe de Seguridad iraní, Mohsen Rezaei, en una entrevista el sábado, reportada por Al Jazeera.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Irán comunicó sus condiciones a los mediadores para retomar las negociaciones destinadas a poner fin a la guerra con Estados Unidos, dijo el jefe de Seguridad iraní, Mohsen Rezaei, en una entrevista el sábado, reportada por Al Jazeera. Las condiciones incluyen el fin de la guerra en todos los frentes, el desbloqueo de los fondos iraníes y el fin del bloqueo naval, dijo Rezaei, quien añadió que continúan las consultas con los mediadores de Qatar y Pakistán, y que Teherán está a la espera de una respuesta del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump.

item.title: White House turns away CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters after Trump's ban
item.description: The White House on Saturday denied access to journalists from CNN, MS NOW and Politico, following through with US President Donald Trump's announcement that he would ban them from the building's grounds.
item.dc:creator: Waylon Cunningham
item.content:encoded: The White House on Saturday denied access to journalists from CNN, MS NOW and Politico, following through with US President Donald Trump's announcement that he would [USN:L6N45A14F TEXT:"ban them"] from the building's grounds. All three news outlets separately said their teams' press passes were confiscated on Saturday morning when their journalists went to the White House. They have signaled that they may contest the ban on the grounds that it conflicts with the US Constitution's First Amendment protections for free speech and a free press. A CNN statement on Saturday called the ban "an illegal assault" on its constitutional right to do journalism without interference from the government. In separate statements, MS NOW and Politico said they would "defend our First Amendment rights." MS NOW said it intends to "take any and all steps necessary to defend our First Amendment rights and the essential role of independent journalism in our democracy." CNN and MS NOW said they would continue reporting on the Trump administration, and Politico said it stands by its reporters covering the White House. A social media post by Trump on Friday accused the outlets of "reporting FAKE NEWS" and said that they "shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they're covering the President of the United States." He added, "Other Fake News Media Outlets to follow." Speaking to reporters in the Oval Office on Friday, Trump answered a question about what he meant by other outlets by describing the New York Times and the Washington Post as examples of "fake news," although he did not specifically say he would ban them from the White House. The New York Times in a statement called Trump's latest ban "yet another retaliatory and unconstitutional threat" and said the newspaper "stands in support of the news organizations being unfairly targeted by the president." The Washington Post in a statement on Saturday said its access to the White House is a "non-negotiable constitutional right," and called the president's actions "a clear form of intimidation meant to silence coverage." Trump previously has tried to keep certain news outlets or specific journalists out of press gatherings. Last year he banned the Associated Press from the pool of reporters that cover his movements because the news agency did not adopt Trump's preferred name for the Gulf of Mexico after the president instructed the executive branch to call it the Gulf of America. AP has [USN:L1N3X00F1 TEXT:"challenged"] the ban. In his first term, Trump's White House sought to revoke or suspend the credentials of Playboy correspondent Brian Karem and CNN's Jim Acosta, but federal judges ordered their White House press passes restored.

item.title: Irã diz ter apresentado as condições para retomar negociações e pôr fim à guerra com EUA
item.description: O Irã comunicou suas condições aos mediadores para retomar as negociações com o objetivo de pôr fim à guerra com os EUA, segundo informou a Al Jazeera, citando declarações do chefe de Segurança do Irã, Mohsen Rezaei, em entrevista concedida no sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Irã comunicou suas condições aos mediadores para retomar as negociações com o objetivo de pôr fim à guerra com os EUA, segundo informou a Al Jazeera, citando declarações do chefe de Segurança do Irã, Mohsen Rezaei, em entrevista concedida no sábado. As condições incluem o fim da guerra em todas as frentes, o destravamento dos fundos iranianos e o fim do bloqueio naval, disse Rezaei, acrescentando que as consultas continuavam com mediadores do Catar e do Paquistão e que Teerã aguardava uma resposta do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump.

item.title: Un général allemand élu à la tête du comité militaire de l'Otan
item.description: Le général Carsten Breuer, chef d'état-major des armées allemandes, a été choisi samedi pour devenir le prochain président du comité militaire de l'Otan, la plus haute autorité militaire de l'Alliance atlantique.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le général Carsten Breuer, chef d'état-major des armées allemandes, a été choisi samedi pour devenir le prochain président du comité militaire de l'Otan, la plus haute autorité militaire de l'Alliance atlantique. Les chefs des armées des 32 pays membres ont élu Carsten Breuer lors d'une réunion à Copenhague, a annoncé l'actuel président du comité, l'amiral italien Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, dans un message sur la plateforme X. L'officier allemand prendra ses fonctions l'été prochain, a-t-il précisé. Le président du comité est le principal conseiller militaire du secrétaire général de l'Alliance, poste occupé actuellement par le Néerlandais Mark Rutte. Agé de 61 ans, Carsten Breuer avait été surnommé le "général du chancelier" lorsqu'il avait été désigné par Olaf Scholz pour diriger un comité de crise chargé de gérer la réponse à la pandémie de Covid-19 en 2021 et 2022. Il a rejoint la Bundeswehr en 1984 au sein d'une unité de défense aérienne. Il a servi en 2014 au sein de la force internationale déployée par l'Otan en Afghanistan.

item.title: African champions beat Asian counterparts to advance in Inter Continental Cup
item.description: African champions Mamelodi Sundowns edged their Asian counterparts Al Ahli of Saudi Arabia 2-1 in the Inter Continental Cup on Saturday, with a double strike from Portuguese import Nuno Santos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: African champions Mamelodi Sundowns edged their Asian counterparts Al Ahli of Saudi Arabia 2-1 in the Inter Continental Cup on Saturday, with a double strike from Portuguese import Nuno Santos. Sundowns advance to a match against either Toluca of Mexico or the Copa Libertadores winners later this year in the annual competition for the six confederation champions. Santos went ahead in the 17th minute lead at Loftus Versfeld but their lead lasted only two minutes until goalkeeper Ronwen Williams saved a close-range effort from Saudi striker Feras but could not hold on to the ball which then hit him on the back of the head and went into his goal. A diving header from Santos won the game for the home side nine minutes from time. “I like to be in those type of positions on the pitch and today it was great that the ball arrived perfectly for me,” he said. Al Ahli, with England international Ivan Toney leading the attack, had several good first-half chances which they squandered. Holders Paris St Germain are directly through to the final of the Inter Continental Cup, which will be played in December. FIFA have yet to announce the dates or venue for the last three games of the competition, which last year were held in Qatar.

item.title: Groenlândia e Dinamarca afirmam que acordo com EUA não cederá soberania
item.description: Dinamarca e Groenlândia afirmaram no sábado que qualquer acordo com os Estados Unidos não comprometerá a soberania da Groenlândia, depois que o presidente Donald Trump disse que o acordo daria a Washington “controle permanente” sobre a segurança da ilha ártica, deixando seu escopo exato pouco claro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dinamarca e Groenlândia afirmaram no sábado que qualquer acordo com os Estados Unidos não comprometerá a soberania da Groenlândia, depois que o presidente Donald Trump disse que o acordo daria a Washington “controle permanente” sobre a segurança da ilha ártica, deixando seu escopo exato pouco claro. Estados Unidos, Dinamarca e Groenlândia anunciaram na noite de sexta-feira que firmaram um acordo para que os EUA desenvolvessem uma presença militar significativa na Groenlândia, proibindo os adversários dos EUA de construir suas próprias bases na ilha. Detalhes-chave do acordo não foram divulgados, incluindo o grau de presença militar dos EUA no território dinamarquês autônomo e se algum poder formal sobre a política externa e os recursos seria cedido a Washington. Dinamarca e Groenlândia expressaram esperança de que o acordo, que deve ser assinado durante a Assembleia Geral da ONU na próxima semana, ponha fim a meses de incerteza provocada pelas ameaças de Trump de assumir o controle da Groenlândia. “A próxima semana pode ser uma boa semana — para a Groenlândia, a Dinamarca e os Estados Unidos”, afirmou o ministro das Relações Exteriores da Dinamarca, Lars Lokke Rasmussen, em comunicado publicado no Facebook no sábado. “Esperamos que este período de incerteza dê lugar a um acordo vinculativo que fortaleça a segurança no Ártico e no Atlântico Norte e, consequentemente, nossa segurança compartilhada dentro da Otan e da Europa — respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, os limites inegociáveis do Reino (da Dinamarca)”, disse ele. Dinamarca e Groenlândia têm insistido repetidamente para que Washington respeite a soberania do Reino da Dinamarca e aceite que a Groenlândia não está à venda.

item.title: TotalEnergies' offshore project in Suriname on track for first output in mid-2028
item.description: French energy company TotalEnergies and its partners in the $12 billion GranMorgu offshore oil and gas project in Suriname are on track to inaugurate output in mid-2028, the head of state-run Staatsolie, Annand Jagesar, said on Saturday during a tour to oversee the development's progress.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French energy company TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) and its partners in the $12 billion GranMorgu offshore oil and gas project in Suriname are on track to inaugurate output in mid-2028, the head of state-run Staatsolie, Annand Jagesar, said on Saturday during a tour to oversee the development's progress. "Together, we are not only developing an energy project, we are writing a new chapter in Suriname's history," said Jagesar during the event in Paramaribo, the capital of the small South American nation. Suriname is seeking to follow neighbouring Guyana's transformation into a major oil producer through offshore developments led by international energy companies. While plenty of oil and gas deposits have been discovered in Suriname's waters since 2019, the country still awaits its first offshore oil and gas output. Wood Mackenzie in 2024 estimated Suriname's discovered resources at more than 2.4 billion barrels of oil and liquids and more than 12.5 trillion cubic feet (TCF) of gas. Companies involved in the project - TotalEnergies, Staatsolie and APA Corp - have already spent about 50% of total investment planned, said TotalEnergies' chairman Patrick Pouyanne. GranMorgu will be the first developing Suriname's vast offshore resources. Well head components, tubing hangers and other materials manufactured in Malaysia are due to be installed soon to control the flow of oil and gas back to the platform via a network of underwater subsea architecture and pipelines, executives said. The project is located in a large offshore area comprising 1.4 million acres known as Block 58. The block has been closely watched as it is adjacent to Exxon Mobil's massive Stabroek block in Guyana. Jagesar also said he hopes to expand the country's offshore oil and gas production in the block, where TotalEnergies is slated to drill four new exploratory wells next year. "I dream of a second project, a second FPSO (Floating Production Storage and Offloading) in Block 58," Jagesar said.

item.title: German general Breuer elected to head top NATO military body
item.description: General Carsten Breuer, Germany's chief of defence, was chosen on Saturday as the next head of NATO's military committee, the alliance's top military authority and a key advisory body for its political leaders.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: General Carsten Breuer, Germany's chief of defence, was chosen on Saturday as the next head of NATO's military committee, the alliance's top military authority and a key advisory body for its political leaders. Military chiefs from the 32-nation alliance elected Breuer at a meeting in Copenhagen, current chair Italian Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone said in a post on X. Breuer will take up the role next summer, succeeding Dragone. "Your operational judgement, your deep familiarity with this Alliance and your leadership of the German Armed Forces will serve NATO well," Dragone wrote, congratulating Breuer. "The Chiefs of Defence have placed their trust in you at a demanding moment for Euro-Atlantic security," he added. The committee is NATO's senior military authority and its chair serves as the main military adviser to its political chief, Secretary General Mark Rutte. Breuer will assume the post at a time of upheaval in the alliance. US President Donald Trump has demanded that European countries take primary responsibility for the continent's defence after decades of American leadership. Many European governments have ramped up defence spending in recent years, driven both by Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine and by Trump's threats not to honour US commitments to NATO. Germany, Europe's largest economy, has been at the forefront of the [USN:L8N4350X7 TEXT:"spending surge."] Berlin aims to double its military expenditure to over €200 billion ($230 billion) by 2030. Breuer, a 61-year-old army officer, earned the nickname "the chancellor's general" after then-Chancellor Olaf Scholz picked him to lead a crisis committee that helped manage Germany's response to the COVID pandemic in 2021 and 2022. He joined the Bundeswehr in an air defence unit in 1984 and later attended the US general staff college in Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, as well as German general staff training in Hamburg. In 2014, he served with NATO's International Security Assistance Force in the Afghan capital Kabul. Germany's current army chief, Lieutenant General Christian Freuding, is expected to succeed Breuer as chief of defence before the end of the year. ($1 = 0.8709 euros)

item.title: Irã executa homem condenado por espionagem para Mossad de Israel
item.description: O Irã executou um homem condenado por passar informações sobre bases de mísseis para Israel durante a guerra de 12 dias, segundo o Poder Judiciário.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Irã executou um homem condenado por passar informações sobre bases de mísseis para Israel durante a guerra de 12 dias, segundo o Poder Judiciário. A agência de notícias Mizan, administrada pelo Poder Judiciário iraniano, informou que Hossein Pedaran foi enforcado após a Suprema Corte manter sua sentença de morte por acusações de espionagem e cooperação em inteligência com Israel. Segundo a agência, Pedaran teria fornecido ao serviço de inteligência israelense Mossad informações sobre instalações militares confidenciais na província central de Isfahan e teria praticado a espionagem com o objetivo de obter ganhos financeiros.

item.title: No. 1 pick Gavin McKenna ready for Maple Leafs' debut
item.description: No. 1 overall draft pick Gavin McKenna is expected to make his NHL debut Saturday night when his Toronto Maple Leafs host the Montreal Canadiens in a preseason game.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: No. 1 overall draft pick Gavin McKenna is expected to make his NHL debut Saturday night when his Toronto Maple Leafs host the Montreal Canadiens in a preseason game. He was Toronto's first No. 1 overall pick since Auston Matthews was selected in 2016. McKenna, 18, is expected to slot in at left wing on a line with center John Tavares and right wing William Nylander after practicing with them in the opening days of training camp. "He's found them a lot with a lot pucks," Toronto coach Jim Hiller said of McKenna, per NHL.com. "So, when you have three guys who can find each other and you're not relying on one guy and maybe the second guy, the way I see it is there is three guys who are moving it around pretty well." Matthews, the Maple Leafs' captain, said he likes what he has seen from McKenna, who played one season at Penn State. "He's great, he plays with a lot of confidence," Matthews said. "I think he's come in right away and found his groove. You can tell when he's on the ice and has the puck, the kind of skill, and the plays that he can make. ... I think he's fitting really well with those guys, and fitting really well with the team so far and seems very comfortable and has the confidence that he knows he's a great player, and that he can play at this level, too." McKenna was a star freshman at Penn State, where he tallied 51 points (15 goals, 36 assists) in 35 games. He also played for Team Canada in the 2026 World Junior Championships, where he notched 14 points (four goals, 10 assists) in seven games for the bronze medalists. He is a native of Whitehorse, the capital of Canada's Yukon territory. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trois Palestiniens tués par Israël dans la bande de Gaza
item.description: Au moins trois Palestiniens ont été tués samedi dans la bande de Gaza par des frappes israéliennes, rapportent les autorités de santé locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Au moins trois Palestiniens ont été tués samedi dans la bande de Gaza par des frappes israéliennes, rapportent les autorités de santé locales. Une frappe près du camp de réfugiés de Jabalia, dans le nord de la ville de Gaza, a coûté la vie à Basir al Bourch, fils de Mounir al Bourch, directeur général du ministère de la Santé du territoire, ont déclaré des médecins et des membres de sa famille. L'armée israélienne a dit avoir pris pour cible des activistes armés, dont Basir al Bourch, sans fournir davantage de précisions. Dans une vidéo obtenue par Reuters, on voit Mounir al Bourch porter le corps de son fils, enveloppé dans une couverture, avec d'autres personnes en deuil, alors qu'il est transporté d'urgence à l'hôpital Al-Shifa en ambulance. "J'étais avec lui dans la tente, et il m'a dit : "Papa, ils vont nous prendre pour cible, toi et moi ensemble." J'ai répondu : "Très bien, nous irons au paradis ensemble" », a déclaré Mounir al Bourch dans la vidéo. "Il est sorti de la tente, ils l'ont frappé et il est mort en martyr, que Dieu ait pitié de lui", a-t-il ajouté. Selon des membres de sa famille et des médecins, Mounir al Bourch a déjà perdu une fille lors d'une frappe aérienne israélienne en décembre 2023. Un homme a également été tué samedi à Chejaia, à l'est de la ville de Gaza, tandis qu'une personne - un combattant du Hamas selon Israël - a péri dans la destruction d'un véhicule dans le quartier de Sheikh Radwan, à Gaza même, ont indiqué secouristes et médecins. Plus de 1.300 Palestiniens, majoritairement des civils, ont été tués à Gaza depuis l'entrée en vigueur d'un cessez-le-feu entre Israël et le Hamas en octobre 2025, selon les autorités de santé du territoire. Quatre soldats israéliens ont été tués durant la même période selon Tsahal. Avant la trêve, la guerre lancée par Israël contre les groupes armés palestiniens dans le territoire après les raids menés par le Hamas en Israël le 7 octobre 2023, qui ont fait quelque 1.200 morts, a coûté la vie à plus de 73.000 personnes dont de nombreux civils, selon les autorités de santé de l'enclave, des chiffres jugés fiables par les Nations unies.

item.title: Ministério das Finanças da França prevê que dívida atinja recorde em 2026, chegando a quase 120% do PIB
item.description: A dívida da França deve atingir um recorde de 119,3% do PIB em 2026, com uma relação dívida/PIB projetada de 121,7% em 2027, informou o Ministério das Finanças no sábado, em mais um sinal da deterioração das finanças públicas do país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A dívida da França deve atingir um recorde de 119,3% do PIB em 2026, com uma relação dívida/PIB projetada de 121,7% em 2027, informou o Ministério das Finanças no sábado, em mais um sinal da deterioração das finanças públicas do país. O Ministério das Finanças apresentou a projeção em uma declaração ao Conselho Superior de Finanças Públicas, órgão encarregado de avaliar as previsões de receitas e despesas na proposta de orçamento do governo. Em 2025, o índice da dívida em relação ao PIB da França era de 115,7%, e estava abaixo de 100% em 2019, segundo dados do governo. O ministério também informou que espera encerrar o ano com um déficit orçamentário de 5,4%. O primeiro-ministro Sébastien Lecornu afirmou na quinta-feira prever que o déficit de 2026 fique bem abaixo de 5,5%. Lecornu anunciou planos para incluir um pacote de economia de 54 bilhões de euros (US$ 62 bilhões) em seu orçamento de 2027 para impedir que o déficit saia do controle, mas enfrenta a difícil tarefa de aprovar medidas de austeridade em um Parlamento profundamente dividido, em meio à crescente pressão dos eleitores em relação ao custo de vida.

item.title: Mookie Betts, Dodgers aim to claim series from rival Giants
item.description: Mookie Betts struggled through the first 2 1/2 months of this season for the Los Angeles Dodgers, and his batting average was below .200 on June 13.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Mookie Betts struggled through the first 2 1/2 months of this season for the Los Angeles Dodgers, and his batting average was below .200 on June 13. But three months later, Betts is in top form as the Dodgers host the San Francisco Giants on Saturday night in the middle contest of a three-game series. Betts went 3-for-4 with two homers and three RBIs in Friday's 8-2 victory to continue a torrid September in which he is batting .356 (21-for-59) with six homers and 18 RBIs in 15 games. The homers and RBIs are the most Betts has produced in any month this season. Betts led off Friday's game with a homer and added a second blast in the eighth, when the Dodgers hit four home runs in the inning. Betts noted that he's batting leadoff solely because Shohei Ohtani (left knee swelling, right biceps inflammation) is on the 15-day injured list. "Going up there is fun," Betts said of batting first. "It feels like home." Betts has back-to-back three-hit games and is batting .254 for the season, with 22 homers and 65 RBIs. The Dodgers led by just one run entering the bottom of the eighth on Friday before they put on a power show against Giants left-hander Philip Abner. Max Muncy and Kyle Tucker hit back-to-back homers to start the frame. Two outs later, Betts hit a two-run blast and Will Smith followed with a solo shot. Rookie Josue De Paula delivered the go-ahead double in the sixth and had two hits and scored twice as the Dodgers prevailed for the 12th time in the past 15 games. "I just like to feel in control of it like I'm the man in the box and I control the moment," De Paula said of his approach. Playoff-bound Los Angeles (94-60) trails the Milwaukee Brewers by two games in the battle for the National League's best record. San Francisco (64-90) has lost five of its last seven games and is missing the playoffs for the fifth straight season and ninth time in the last 10. Management said earlier this week that manager Tony Vitello will return for a second season. The Giants haven't named a starter for Saturday after ace right-hander Logan Webb (blister on right middle finger) was placed on the 15-day injured list. Webb was an All-Star for the third straight season but is just 8-9 with a 4.31 ERA in 27 starts. "It's been a weird season," he said before Friday's game. "It's been very up and down. I think as a team in general, but for myself, especially. It's been either really good or really bad. There's been way too many bad ones. Left-hander Tarik Skubal (10-7, 2.70 ERA) will start for Los Angeles on Saturday. He will make his ninth start for the Dodgers since being acquired from the Detroit Tigers at the trade deadline last month. Skubal is 3-2 with a 2.52 ERA in 50 innings with Los Angeles. He has 57 strikeouts against 11 walks. Skubal, 29, is slated to become a free agent following the season but continues to fit in with the Dodgers. After Los Angeles clinched the National League West title on Thursday, Skubal and fellow lefty Blake Snell were celebrating when Skubal said: "It's going to be special. It's gonna be the first of many." Skubal stood out in his last two outings, both victories over the Cincinnati Reds. He gave up two runs and seven hits over 14 1/3 innings, with the more recent outing coming Monday in a 4-1 win. Skubal is 1-1 with a 2.79 ERA in two career starts against the Giants. --Field Level Media

item.title: Chamas e fumaça são vistas perto de aeroporto de Riad; Houthis reivindicam ataques à capital saudita
item.description: Os houthis do Iêmen afirmaram ter atacado locais "sensíveis" na capital saudita, Riad, neste sábado, com mísseis e drones, horas depois de chamas e uma grande coluna de fumaça terem sido vistas perto do principal aeroporto da cidade.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os houthis do Iêmen afirmaram ter atacado locais "sensíveis" na capital saudita, Riad, neste sábado, com mísseis e drones, horas depois de chamas e uma grande coluna de fumaça terem sido vistas perto do principal aeroporto da cidade. A Arábia Saudita havia emitido alertas durante a noite sobre possíveis riscos nas imediações de Riad, em meio a uma escalada de ataques dos houthis no reino. Vídeos e fotografias da Reuters mostraram uma enorme coluna de fumaça preta subindo na área, com a rodovia do aeroporto, o edifício do terminal principal e outras instalações em primeiro plano. Em um momento do vídeo, chamas eram visíveis subindo por trás do que pareciam ser tanques de combustível. Os houthis não especificaram o que visavam em Riad, mas informaram que também atacaram uma instalação da Aramco na cidade de Yanbu, às margens do Mar Vermelho — um importante centro de exportação de petróleo da Arábia Saudita. Os houthis disseram que a operação foi uma resposta a um ataque na capital iemenita, Sanaa. Não houve comentário imediato do escritório de imprensa do governo saudita em resposta às perguntas da Reuters sobre a fumaça e os alertas emitidos durante a madrugada. A defesa civil saudita enviou os alertas por telefone durante a madrugada sobre um possível perigo de ataques aéreos em Riad e na cidade de Al-Kharj, a leste da capital, antes de emitir um aviso de fim de alerta na manhã de sábado. Um jornalista da Reuters na região de Olaya, em Riad, ouviu estrondos antes que o aviso de fim de alerta fosse enviado. Embora alguns alertas tenham sido emitidos em Riad este ano após o início da guerra entre os EUA e o Irã, esses foram os primeiros desde que a escalada começou com os houthis em julho. Os houthis, que controlam as regiões mais populosas do Iêmen e grande parte do norte do país, vêm lançando ataques contra a Arábia Saudita desde que declararam um bloqueio naval contra Riad em julho, com ataques direcionados a embarcações sauditas no Mar Vermelho. Os ataques têm como alvo cidades sauditas, infraestrutura energética e transporte marítimo, criando novas ameaças ao abastecimento global de petróleo e colocando em risco a principal rota alternativa pelo Mar Vermelho para as exportações do Golfo, enquanto o tráfego pelo Estreito de Ormuz permanece bloqueado.

item.title: French finance ministry expects record debt in 2026, reaching nearly 120% of GDP
item.description: France's debt is expected to reach a record high of 119.3% of output in 2026, with a projected debt-to-GDP ratio of 121.7% in 2027, the finance ministry said on Saturday, in the latest indication of the country's deteriorating public finances.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France's debt is expected to reach a record high of 119.3% of output in 2026, with a projected debt-to-GDP ratio of 121.7% in 2027, the finance ministry said on Saturday, in the latest indication of the country's deteriorating public finances. The finance ministry made the projection in a declaration to the High Council of Public Finances, the body tasked with evaluating revenue and expenditure forecasts in the government's budget proposal. In 2025, France's debt-to-GDP ratio was 115.7%, and it was below 100% in 2019, according to government data. The ministry also said it expects to end the year with a budget deficit of 5.4%. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu [USN:L8N4591JN TEXT:"said on Thursday"] he expected the 2026 deficit to be well below 5.5%. Lecornu has announced plans to include a €54 billion ($62 billion) savings drive in his 2027 budget to stop the deficit spiralling out of control, but he faces a tough task to push austerity measures through a deeply divided parliament amid mounting pressure from voters over the cost of living. The premium France pays to borrow on the bond markets compared to Germany [USN:L1N45A0PZ TEXT:"rose to more than a whole percentage point"] on Friday for the first time since the euro zone debt crisis, underscoring investor unease with its stretched finances ahead of elections next year. ($1 = 0.8709 euros)

item.title: Francia prevé que la deuda alcance un récord en 2026, en casi el 120% del PIB
item.description: La deuda de Francia alcanzaría un máximo histórico del 119,3% del PIB en 2026, y del 121,7% en 2027, pronostico el sábado el Ministerio de Hacienda, en lo que supone una nueva señal de deterioro de las finanzas públicas del país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La deuda de Francia alcanzaría un máximo histórico del 119,3% del PIB en 2026, y del 121,7% en 2027, pronostico el sábado el Ministerio de Hacienda, en lo que supone una nueva señal de deterioro de las finanzas públicas del país. El Ministerio de Hacienda presentó la previsión en una declaración ante el Alto Consejo de Finanzas Públicas, el organismo encargado de evaluar las previsiones de ingresos y gastos en la propuesta de presupuesto del Gobierno. En 2025, la ratio deuda/PIB de Francia había sido del 115,7%, y en 2019 era menor al 100 %, según datos del Gobierno. El ministerio también señaló que prevé cerrar el año con un déficit presupuestario del 5,4%. El primer ministro, Sébastien Lecornu, había dicho el jueves que esperaba que el déficit de 2026 se situara muy por debajo del 5,5%. Lecornu ha anunciado planes para incluir un plan de ahorro de 54.000 millones de euros (62.000 millones de dólares) en su presupuesto de 2027 con el fin de evitar que el déficit se dispare sin control, pero se enfrenta a la difícil tarea de hacer aprobar medidas de austeridad en un Parlamento profundamente dividido, y bajo creciente presión de los votantes por el costo de la vida. La prima que Francia paga por endeudarse en los mercados de bonos en comparación con Alemania subió el viernes a más de 1 punto porcentual por primera vez desde la crisis de la deuda de la zona del euro, lo que pone de relieve el malestar de los inversores ante la precaria situación financiera del país antes de las elecciones del próximo año. (1 dólar = 0,8709 euros)

item.title: Angels' Reid Detmers aims to continue strong run vs. Twins
item.description: Los Angeles Angels left-hander Reid Detmers will try to continue a strong finish to his breakout season on Saturday night when he faces the Minnesota Twins in Anaheim, Calif.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Angels left-hander Reid Detmers will try to continue a strong finish to his breakout season on Saturday night when he faces the Minnesota Twins in Anaheim, Calif. Detmers (6-8, 3.36 ERA) has a majors-best 1.65 ERA in 11 starts since the All-Star break with 76 strikeouts and 11 walks in 65 1/3 innings. He needs one more strikeout to become the 12th pitcher in franchise history to record 200 strikeouts in a season, and the first since Shohei Ohtani in 2022. Detmers is 1-2 with a 5.40 ERA in seven career appearances (five starts) against Minnesota. He brings a streak of seven consecutive quality starts into the contest after helping pitch Los Angeles (59-95) to a 6-4 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Monday, allowing three runs on seven hits and a walk in six innings with eight strikeouts. Cal Raleigh belted a three-run homer to snap a streak of six consecutive starts that Detmers made pitching at least six innings while allowing one or fewer runs. "I just felt like I didn't have my best stuff tonight, but was able to get through six and only give up the home run to Cal, so I was very satisfied with that," Detmers said. "You're not always going to have your best stuff, so sometimes you have to give and take with what you've got." Right-hander Joe Ryan (6-10, 3.84) will make his third start for Minnesota (72-82) since coming off the 15-day injured list with a left glute strain. Ryan is 2-0 with a 3.10 ERA in five career starts against Los Angeles with 41 strikeouts in 29 innings. He didn't figure in the decision in a 5-3 win over the Angels on July 11 at Target Field when he gave up two runs on six hits in six innings with two walks and six strikeouts. Ryan is 0-5 in five starts since the All-Star break and comes in off a 9-2 loss to the Cleveland Guardians on Sunday, allowing four runs on seven hits in four innings with just one strikeout. Steven Kwan homered on the second pitch of the game and Jo Adell added a solo homer in the third for Cleveland. He departed after throwing 84 pitches, 51 for strikes. "I think 'battle' is probably the best way to put it," Ryan said. "Just kind of long at-bats, throwing the ball for the most part where we wanted to throw it. They were just kind of beating me to it there. It's frustrating when it's a day like that, and yeah, they've had a pretty good approach all year I would say." Los Angeles posted a 5-4 win in 10 innings on Thursday before Minnesota evened the four-game series with a 3-0 victory on Friday night. Walker Jenkins homered and had his second straight three-hit game for the Twins. The 21-year-old Jenkins, ranked Minnesota's top prospect by MLB.com, entered the series batting .089 (4-for-45) with 16 strikeouts but is 6-for-8 with two home runs and three RBIs in the first two games against the Angels. "I think jumping levels, it's always mental," Jenkins said of overcoming his slow big league start. "I think obviously guys are better but it's a mental adjustment. Bigger stadiums, more people, better arms, and I think I just had to settle in a little bit. I wouldn't say I have it figured out yet, but we're going to continue to stack good days and hopefully help the team win." --Field Level Media

item.title: Mariners strive for strong finish, brace for rematch vs. Rockies
item.description: The playoffs likely aren't in the immediate future for the Seattle Mariners, but that won't impact how they play their final eight games.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The playoffs likely aren't in the immediate future for the Seattle Mariners, but that won't impact how they play their final eight games. Seattle (72-82) recorded a 5-4 victory Friday in the opener of a three-game series against the Colorado Rockies in Denver. The Mariners will take on the Rockies again on Saturday night, sending right-hander Bryce Miller (4-9, 4.19 ERA) to the mound. Miller has faced Colorado once in his career, giving up three runs on five hits in 5 2/3 innings in Seattle last Sept. 23. He received a no-decision in the Mariners' 4-3 win that clinched a playoff berth for the team and sparked a postseason path that nearly stretched to the franchise's first World Series appearance. This season, Seattle manager Dan Wilson wants to finish strong after his team dropped two of three games vs. the Los Angeles Angels ahead of the series with the Rockies. "We've got to keep going, we've got to keep playing," Wilson said of his team, which remains mathematically alive in the playoff race. "Coming out of a tough series there in Anaheim, I thought the first game and the last game really approached it well. We've got to continue to take that mentality and continue to do the things that make us successful offensively in a ballpark like this (Coors Field). "You've got to really find ways to add on. You've got to really push, and this is a ballpark where strange things can happen." Colorado (56-98) is accustomed to strange things happening in its home park, and the team has a knack of making things interesting with late rallies. The Rockies erased a 3-0 deficit to claim a 4-3 lead on Friday but couldn't hold on. While the rallies have been exciting, Colorado is on the verge of a fourth straight 100-loss season. The Rockies have improved from their 119-loss campaign in 2025 and surpassed last year's win total (43) before August of this season. However, since sitting 45-67 on Aug. 2, Colorado is 11-31 and has struggled to get solid starting pitching. The rotation has not recorded a win in 21 games but could get a boost with the return of left-hander Jose Quintana, 37, as the starter on Saturday. The veteran, who signed a one-year deal in the offseason, is 2-3 with a 5.27 ERA in nine starts this year, but his last one came May 24 at Arizona. A left elbow sprain has sidelined him since then, but he had a goal of pitching again before the end of the season. "He's a 15-year vet that got hurt in May -- it would be easy for a guy like that, with all that time, to just shut it down and call it a day," Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer said. "But he set an example for all the young players." Quintana is 2-2 with a 3.58 ERA in 13 career appearances (nine starts) vs. the Mariners. --Field Level Media

item.title: Martin recovers from early setback to win Austrian sprint and retake championship lead
item.description: Aprilia's Jorge Martin made an extraordinary recovery from a chaotic opening-lap battle with championship rival Marc Marquez to win the Austrian Grand Prix sprint from pole position on Saturday and reclaim the MotoGP championship lead.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Aprilia's Jorge Martin made an extraordinary recovery from a chaotic opening-lap battle with championship rival Marc Marquez to win the Austrian Grand Prix sprint from pole position on Saturday and reclaim the MotoGP championship lead. Martin, who had stormed to [USN:L4N45B027 TEXT:"pole position"] ahead of reigning MotoGP champion Marquez earlier on Saturday, beat the Ducati rider to claim his 20th sprint victory after KTM's Pedro Acosta crashed out while leading in the closing stages. The 28-year-old Martin, the 2024 MotoGP champion, now has 286 points in the standings, three ahead of Spanish compatriot Marquez, heading into Sunday's Grand Prix at the Red Bull Ring in Spielberg. Martin's race appeared to unravel in the opening corners when he was forced on to the defensive by seven-time MotoGP champion Marquez, ran wide and dropped to eighth. Acosta capitalised to take command and built a lead of nearly three seconds, only to crash out with about three laps remaining at KTM's home circuit. Martin, meanwhile, carved his way back through the pack to secure a remarkable victory. "I enjoyed the race for sure," Martin said. "I was a bit lucky with Pedro because we thought that I would be second. We started well but then we were on the limit on the first lap, so I thought my chances were over. "But then, lap by lap, I didn't give up during the race. I was pushing till my maximum, trying to be super concentrated to come from the back and then win. The end was so good. "I am really happy for my team because they really deserve it. We are ready for tomorrow. I hope that we can continue at this pace." Marquez had seized the championship lead for the first time this season by winning last weekend's chaotic [USN:L1N455030 TEXT:"San Marino Grand Prix"] . The result had left him level on points with Martin but the 33-year-old moved to the top of the standings by virtue of having won more races this season. "Today the target was third place in the sprint and I tried not to lose a lot of points against Jorge because it's already in practice that Pedro and Jorge had a better pace," Marquez said. "Then I found the position where I sat just behind Jorge, and we were a bit lucky with Pedro's mistake. But happy and ready for tomorrow." Aprilia's Marco Bezzecchi, third in the championship standings, completed the podium. Trackhouse Aprilia's Ai Ogura finished fourth with Alex Marquez fifth.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill three people in Gaza, medics say
item.description: Israeli airstrikes killed at least three Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Saturday, health officials said.
item.dc:creator: Nidal Al-Mughrabi
item.content:encoded: Israeli airstrikes killed at least three Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Saturday, health officials said. One strike near Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza killed Basir Al-Bursh, the son of Munir Al-Bursh, the territory's health ministry director-general, medics and family members said. The Israeli military said it had struck several militants on Saturday, including Basir Al-Bursh, without giving further information. Hamas, the Palestinian militant group that runs Gaza, did not immediately comment. Munir Al-Bursh lost a daughter in an Israeli airstrike in December 2023, according to family members and medics. He was wounded in that attack. In video obtained by Reuters, Al-Bursh was seen carrying his son's body, wrapped in a blanket, with other mourners as it was rushed to hospital by ambulance. "I was with him in the tent, and he said, Dad, they will target us, you and me together, I said that is fine, we will go to heaven together," said Al-Bursh in the video. "He went outside the tent and they struck him and he was martyred, may God have mercy on him," added Al-Bursh. At Al Shifa Hospital, Al-Bursh could barely stand as mourners arrived to pay their respects. Elsewhere, a strike killed a man in Shejaia, east of Gaza City, while another hit a vehicle in the Sheikh Radwan district of Gaza City, killing one person, the civil defence service and medics said, taking Saturday's death toll to at least three. The Israeli military said the Sheikh Radwan strike targeted a Hamas militant. The blast reduced the vehicle to a mangled wreck. Palestinian authorities say more than 73,000 people have been killed in Israel's assault on Gaza, launched after Hamas-led fighters killed about 1,200 people in southern Israel in October 2023. A US-brokered [USN:L8N4590HK TEXT:"ceasefire"] agreed last year calls for the eventual reconstruction of the territory, but little progress has been made as negotiators have failed to agree terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops. More than 1,300 Palestinians, mostly civilians, have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire took effect, according to the territory's health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed.

item.title: Torrid Padres take on Marlins, hoping to keep pace in NL wild-card race
item.description: Friday night couldn't have gone any better for the San Diego Padres.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Friday night couldn't have gone any better for the San Diego Padres. Not only did they continue their scalding September with an 8-2 defeat of the visiting Miami Marlins, but losses by the Chicago Cubs and Philadelphia enabled the Padres (85-69) to forge a three-way tie atop the National League wild-card standings. And their magic number to clinch a playoff spot was reduced to four when the New York Yankees defeated Arizona. San Diego will hope for similar results on Saturday when it looks to improve to 5-0 this season against Miami. The Padres are presently flying on a rocket ship to the postseason. They've won 11 of their last 12 games and have scored at least six runs in seven of their last eight. The idea of actually hosting a wild-card series is now taking on serious traction. While San Diego would lose any tiebreaker with the Phillies or Cubs, it is easily the hottest of the three clubs coming down the home stretch. "The only thing that we can worry about is playing each game the best we can and playing to our standard," said manager Craig Stammen. "That first playoff game, we would love for it to be in San Diego." The Padres are 47-29 in Petco Park, including a 22-5 mark dating back to July 10. The only home series they've lost since late June came at Pittsburgh's hands in late August. "We're in a good spot going into these last eight games," said first baseman Ty France, who belted his career-high 21st homer to cap a six-run fifth inning Friday night. "Hopefully, we can just keep things going." Casey Mize (6-9, 3.69 ERA) will try to string together consecutive wins for San Diego. He scattered eight hits over five innings Monday night in an 8-7 victory at Colorado, allowing two runs. He is 1-1 with a 2.31 ERA in two prior starts against Miami. Eury Perez (7-11, 3.99) looks to escape the roughest patch of his season, one that's seen him allow 19 earned runs in his last four starts, covering 16 2/3 innings. The best start in that stretch came Sunday in a 6-4 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers. Perez made it through five innings, allowing four hits and three runs with two walks and five strikeouts. Control has been an issue as he's doled out 12 walks in that span. He's 0-1 with a 3.75 ERA in two career outings against San Diego. The loss came on July 25, when he worked seven innings and yielded three runs in an eventual 7-2 defeat that was the 11th game in a 12-game losing streak that eventually took Miami (76-78) out of the running. With Miami out of the playoffs for a third straight season, it will use the remaining time to try to find answers for an inconsistent bullpen. Season-ending injuries to closer Pete Fairbanks and setup man Anthony Bender have made things harder. Manager Clayton McCullough said he won't have a set closer over the final eight games. "We just look at using the best people we have to get to that point and then whoever's left will get that opportunity," he said. --Field Level Media
